title: Why Multi-Factor Authentication Matters
summary: Multi-factor authentication adds an additional verification step and can reduce the impact of stolen passwords.

title: Phishing Emails Continue to Target Online Accounts
summary: Users should carefully inspect unexpected messages, sender addresses and links before providing sensitive information.

title: Ransomware Awareness: Protecting Important Files
summary: Regular backups, software updates, strong authentication and security awareness can reduce ransomware-related risks.

title: Protecting Personal Information Online
summary: Review privacy settings, minimize unnecessary data sharing and use unique passwords for important accounts.

title: Malware Prevention Basics
summary: Keep operating systems and applications updated and avoid downloading files from untrusted sources.

title: How to Recognize Suspicious Links
summary: Unexpected domains, unusual URL structures and urgent requests for information can be warning signs.

title: Security Updates Should Not Be Ignored
summary: Software updates can include security fixes that address vulnerabilities discovered after software was released.

title: Understanding Data Breach Notifications
summary: If a service reports a data breach, review the affected information, change reused passwords and monitor relevant accounts.
